title: Led IBM India's Hackday 8 across the country
summary: In my third year I led IBM India's Hackday 8 as its India-wide coordinator.
what_would_have_happened: The India-wide hackday would have run without a single lead coordinator.
the_call: Step up from coordinating sessions to leading the whole India event.
what_i_did: Led and coordinated Hackday 8 across IBM India, and also competed with a stretch project.
what_changed: Event delivered; my own project won Best Implementation in Pune; the VP later recognized the lab's three-year hackday progress.
